biomass.input_status: published initial biomass with authored growth and grazing coefficients

depth_m.input_status: fixed DEM-derived cell volume divided by surface area

foodweb.input_status: authored initial prey stocks and transfer rates

mammals.input_status: primary-source occurrence catalogue; authored populations, resource demand and encounter probabilities; local abundance unknown

oxygen_mg_l.input_status: authored initial saturation and transfer coefficients

periphyton.input_status: authored initial biomass and growth coefficients

runoff_mm.input_status: bucket overflow plus drainage; catchment area defaults to zero

snow.input_status: weather forcing with authored degree-day and soil-bucket coefficients

snow_mm.input_status: weather forcing with authored degree-day coefficients

soil_temperature_c.component_id: ground heat flux and soil temperature
soil_temperature_c.equation_component: ground heat flux and soil temperature
soil_temperature_c.input_status: published spatial ground heat with authored conductivity and fixed sampling depth

soil_water_mm.input_status: authored soil-bucket capacity, drainage and evaporation

solutes.input_status: frozen source chemistry; authored zero baseline for unknown upstream solutes

trout.input_status: thermal anchors and authored habitat weights

trout_suitability_u.input_status: chronic exposure temperature with authored habitat weights

vegetation.input_status: published initial biomass with authored growth and grazing coefficients

velocity_mps.input_status: prescribed face discharge divided by estimated cross-section

weather.input_status: scenario weather or labeled frozen meteorological series

geography: Fixed Midway scene; x east, z south, y elevation minus 2200m. Routes refer to retained NPS Firehole polyline point indices.

ledger.external_ownership_policy: qualified grazer owner allocates the complete patch/species proxy stock; display counts do not add population
ledger.predation_accounting: proxy removals only; no energetic or physical mass balance

parameter_provenance.all_reach_volumes: Illustrative lumped compartments; not bathymetric measurements.
parameter_provenance.biomass_and_insect_resources: Dimensionless relative indices; growth and consumption rates are artistic simulation coefficients, not kg or organism counts.
parameter_provenance.boundary_c: Illustrative upstream temperature; gauge-data calibration is future work.
parameter_provenance.boundary_m3s: Illustrative constant upstream inflow, not a USGS gauge measurement.
parameter_provenance.cooling_seconds: Illustrative Newton heat-exchange time constants; no vapor mass, chemistry or full surface-energy solver.
parameter_provenance.excelsior_flow: 0.26m3/s chosen illustrative source; NPS describes >4000US gal/min, equivalent to >0.25236m3/s. This is not an exact source observation.
parameter_provenance.excelsior_source_c: Illustrative 62C after outflow cooling at the river entry; not pool/vent temperature and not measured at an outlet.
parameter_provenance.river_topology: One serial Firehole chain. All actual tributaries other than the authored Excelsior heat source are folded into the uncalibrated boundary or omitted; no cold-refuge claim.
parameter_provenance.species_counts: Authored representative proxies, not an estimate of abundance.
